card.name: The word overdose in overdosage sections
card.fires_on: The word overdose or overdosage, including its first part "overd" or the "dosage" after "over", in overdosage sections of drug labels. It follows phrases like "acute", "in case of" or "treatment of".

modes.label: Split word
modes.description: The first piece "overd" or "dosage" of a word that is split, right after acute, of, or with.
modes.example: In premarketing trials involving more than 3100 patients and/or normal subjects, accidental or intentional acute<< overd>>osage of olanzapine was

modes.label: Whole word
modes.description: The whole word overdose after "in case of".
modes.example: In case of<< overdose>>, call Poison Control Center at 1

card.plain: It lights up on the word overdose or overdosage when the label discusses overdose.
